blocks.orig: Be ready to rub your eyes, because Qambani Luxury Resort will make you feel like you’ve landed in paradise. It boasts six very stylish villas in different sizes that are completely in sync with the magical atmosphere of Zanzibar, each designed in its own style and offering a lot of privacy. Some of the villas boast private little pools on the ocean’s edge, while others offer outside showers or a standalone bathtub. All villas are beautifully decorated with spacious living areas and private verandahs (sometimes on a rooftop) with sea views. On the ocean’s front, you find an amazing restaurant, public sitting area and infinity pool, all together perfectly suited for leisurely afternoons or evenings.
blocks.html: You may need to rub your eyes, because at Qambani Luxury Resort it feels as though you’ve arrived in paradise. The resort has six very stylish villas of varying sizes that match the magical atmosphere of Zanzibar perfectly; each has its own style and plenty of privacy. A few villas have small private pools right at the edge of the ocean, while others have outdoor showers or a freestanding bathtub. Every villa is beautifully furnished, with roomy living areas and private verandahs (some on a rooftop) looking out to sea. Along the ocean’s edge there is a wonderful restaurant, a shared lounge area and an infinity pool, together ideal for relaxed afternoons or evenings.

blocks.orig: What makes Qambani even more special, is that it’s an ecological resort where solar power and the newest environmentally friendly techniques are combined with luxury and comfort. The perfect place for those looking to enjoy the holiday of their lives in style!
blocks.html: Qambani is all the more special because it’s an eco resort that combines solar power and the latest environmentally friendly techniques with luxury and comfort. An ideal place if you want to spend the holiday of a lifetime in style!
